text: Tarvitz serves as a captain of the Emperor’s Children. During the fighting on Murder, he helps the surviving warriors contend with the megarachnid and questions choices driven by prestige rather than practical need.

His encounters with [[garviel-loken|Loken]] and other Imperial warriors establish bonds that cross Legion boundaries. He is more comfortable with dependable service than with the relentless pursuit of personal distinction.
Tarvitz uncovers signs that the Isstvan operation is intended to destroy selected Imperial troops. He takes a craft to the surface and warns the deployed warriors before the virus attack.

After the firestorm, he helps unite survivors from different Legions into a defence. The resistance delays Horus’s forces, but Tarvitz and his companions are left facing the final bombardment with no route of escape.
